doctrine_note: The immutable blind stays the CORE predictor; this is a POSTERIOR UPDATE, not a replacement. Magnitudes are DERIVED from the vol_regime sigma scale (n0_net_sigma_10 = 648, n0_net_sigma_5 = 737, n0_range_20_mean = 1094, n0_range_pctile 81.7, frozen at the 20260522 anchor vintage) times a multiplier set by the STRENGTH of the causal stack - never fitted to the realized number. Two of four owned days take a direction change from the blind; each is carried by NEW causal evidence (a restored input, a structural calendar force, or the size-weighted big-print channel), not by re-reading the same state harder. Attribution is stated per day: where a RESTORED INPUT (weather, vol_regime) earned the improvement rather than my reasoning, it is labelled as such and must NOT be banked as forward evidence for a flow play. Per-event only, never pooled as a conclusion. NG is not WTI.

cross_cutting_mbo_finding.headline: The G20 down lean is NOT a chain-state bug and NOT a flow-reading bug. It is a GATE-CONSTRUCTION bug plus two missing inputs: selector.divergence_resolution gate (b) cannot admit the up angle in a shoulder rally by construction, and the blind read an extreme-and-WORSENING managed-money short as bearish when it is the ARMING condition for the covering that actually drove the block.

finding_1_absolute_bshare_gate.claim_from_blind: The absolute 0.50 session_b_share gate in selector.divergence_resolution gate (b) is DEAD in this block; I proposed replacing it with a BLOCK-RELATIVE evaluation or a count-vs-size-weighted channel divergence.
finding_1_absolute_bshare_gate.diagnosis_verdict: CONFIRMED. Realized session_b_share across the ten G20 sessions: 0.367, 0.486, 0.440, 0.448, 0.458, 0.513, 0.488, 0.487, 0.451, 0.445. Only 0.513 clears 0.50 and it sits on the degenerate 1,224-trade Sunday reopen (1 big print) - i.e. on every session with a usable tape the gate is sub-0.50. Gate (b) therefore excluded the weather-up angle on 10/10 days BY CONSTRUCTION while the block ran +1860 on the forward curve. A gate that cannot fire is not a discriminator, it is a constant.
finding_1_absolute_bshare_gate.proposed_remedy_verdict: REFUTED - and this is the more useful half of the result. I tested my own blind proposal: recentre session_b_share on the block's own guard-clean mean (~0.459) and treat above/below as the buy/sell nowcast. Next-session direction under that rule: prior 0525 b 0.486 HIGH -> 0526 -190 (miss); 0526 0.440 LOW -> 0527 +610 (miss); 0527 0.448 LOW -> 0528 +2100 (miss); 0601 0.488 HIGH -> 0602 -80 (miss); 0602 0.487 HIGH -> 0603 +750 (hit); 0603 0.451 LOW -> 0604 +1130 (miss); 0604 0.445 LOW -> 0605 -1340 (hit). 2 of 8. Block-relative recentring of the COUNT tape is no better than the absolute bar. The count-tape aggressor share is not a day-grain direction nowcast in a shoulder-injection rally at all, at any centring.
finding_1_absolute_bshare_gate.consequence: Do NOT recentre gate (b). REPLACE it. The correct discriminator is the SIZE-WEIGHTED big-print channel benchmarked against the per-quartile equal-rate bars already measured in play 61 (flow.big_print_bshare_thin_tape_guard: pooled mean 0.461, p50 0.479 on the corrected size-weighted series; equal-rate bar 0.579 for <=20 prints, 0.536/0.544/0.547 for the three thicker quartiles). That is finding 3.

finding_2_cot_wow_sign_flip.claim_from_blind: The COT WoW sign FLIPS inside the block (+23,762 -> -38,123), so the covering gate and the seam-gap play point opposite ways in the two halves, and that one open-time field is what split my four days 2 down / 2 up.
finding_2_cot_wow_sign_flip.verdict: CONFIRMED as the split, but my blind READ of the second half was wrong in a way that generalizes. Week 1 (report 2026-05-19, published 05-22): managed_money_net -96,303, chg_wow +23,762, 1y pctile 16.0 = shorts COVERING. Week 2 (report 2026-05-26, published 05-29): managed_money_net -134,426, chg_wow -38,123, 1y pctile 0.94, 3y pctile 2.23 = shorts BUILDING to a one-year extreme. The blind treated week 2's -38,123 as bearish confirmation and carried the down lean into 0602/0603. It is not bearish. An extreme-AND-worsening managed-money short at the <=1st percentile is FUEL, not direction: it is the ARMING condition of selector.midblock_right_the_ship / the specialist-C accumulation arm. Both halves of this block were operationally UP - week 1 because covering was already running (0527 +610, 0528 +2100), week 2 because the crowd rebuilt a 1st-percentile short straight into a rising market and then had to cover it again (0603 +750, 0604 +1130).
finding_2_cot_wow_sign_flip.general_mechanism: sign(managed_money_net_chg_wow) is only a direction read when the LEVEL is unremarkable. Once managed_money_net_pctile_1y <= ~2, the WoW sign inverts in meaning: a more-negative WoW is an arming increment, not a bearish increment. The blind applied one sign convention across a percentile boundary the block crossed mid-stream.

finding_3_price_free_absorption_proxy.claim_from_blind: While aggregate signed flow is POSITIVE, watch the size-weighted big-print channel: big prints STILL SELLING = absorber present = buy-absorption-failing risk live (take the turn small); big prints FLIPPING BUY on a guard-clean sample = absorber gone = accumulation confirmed. Claimed to resolve the G18-0506 trap WITHOUT price.
finding_3_price_free_absorption_proxy.verdict: SURVIVES on the arm it was stated for, with a hard scope restriction that I am reporting because it materially limits the claim. It fires on 2 of 10 G20 sessions; both fire correctly, both land on days I own, and both are days the blind got wrong in polarity or size. It is a PARTIAL substitute for flow_conviction - it covers the sign(aggregate flow) = POSITIVE half only.

finding_3_price_free_absorption_proxy.guard_case_and_forward_evidence_for_play: 20260525 session -> 20260526: aggregate signed_flow +1094 (precondition met) and big_print_b_share 0.599 - which would read as a buy-flip and fire the accumulation arm. But big_prints_n = 13, inside play 61's thin quartile (q1, sd 0.255, median 9 prints), where the guard raises the bar to ~0.60. 0.599 < 0.60 -> the arm STANDS DOWN. Actual 0526 = -190 DOWN. Un-guarded, both the flat 0.55 bar and even q1's own 0.579 equal-rate bar would have fired an accumulation call into a down day. This is a live G20 FORWARD-VALIDATING instance for play 61, whose forward_evidence field currently reads NONE and which explicitly rides G20+. The guard is load-bearing to the proxy, not decoration: without it the proxy goes 2 correct / 1 wrong instead of 2 correct / 1 correctly-silent.
finding_3_price_free_absorption_proxy.mirror_arm_REFUTED: I tested the obvious extension - aggregate flow NEGATIVE with big prints BUYING = sellers absorbed by size = accumulation under a sell tape. It does not hold in G20. prior 0527 (sflow -4910, bigB 0.529) -> 0528 +2100 UP; prior 0528 (-1966, 0.522) -> 0529 -160 DOWN; prior 0604 (-5662, 0.533) -> 0605 -1340 DOWN; prior 0603 (-2852, 0.476 SELL) -> 0604 +1130 UP. Two up, two down, and the single sell-side reading preceded the block's second-largest up day. Under a SELLING count tape the big-print channel carries no next-session information here. The proxy is an ABSORBER-DETECTION gate on a BUYING count tape, not a general direction generator.
finding_3_price_free_absorption_proxy.answer_to_the_G19_open_question: It is a HALF substitute for flow_conviction, not a full one. flow_conviction = sign(signed_flow) * sign(price_change) spans all four sign combinations; the proxy spans only sign(signed_flow) = +. It does resolve the G18-0506 class - a buy tape being absorbed, a turn stack that built but did not deliver - which is precisely the failure play 51 flags in its own forward_evidence ('the mid-block re-derivation must confirm the turn DELIVERED, not just that the stack built'). On 0601 the stack had built and the big prints said the turn would NOT deliver; 0602 came in -80. On 0602 the big prints flipped and said it WOULD; 0603 came in +750. That is a genuine price-free delivery test. It does NOT resolve the sell-tape-being-absorbed class (0527, 0604), and in G20 that class is exactly where the largest forward-curve errors sat. That half stays carried by weather run-deltas, COT arming state and calendar structure - not by flow.
finding_3_price_free_absorption_proxy.n_and_honesty: n = 2 firings + 1 correct guard stand-down inside one block. That is thin. I am reporting it as a mechanism with a stated precondition and a stated refuted extension, not as an established play.

cross_cutting_mbo_finding.why_the_lean_survived_the_cum_0_fix: Nothing in this block's lean needed chain state to go wrong. The blind's down angle on my days was produced by three independent constructions that all point down in a shoulder and none of which the cum-0 fix touches: (i) selector.divergence_resolution gate (a) - near-window max HDD versus the ~16.4 band-authority threshold - is unreachable in a mod_cool shoulder where forecast gw_HDD runs 0.28-1.07, so the weather-up angle is gated out on every single day before any evidence is weighed; (ii) gate (b) is sub-0.50 on 10/10 sessions and so cannot restore it; (iii) the week-2 COT WoW sign was read as bearish across a percentile boundary where its meaning inverts. Three down-by-construction paths and no admissible up path. The S105 lens already warns that 'the S3-down default is not sign-certain just because the HDD>=16.4 catalyst-override is gated out' - G20 is the clean demonstration. The fix is not another chain repair; it is giving the selector an up-path that can actually fire in a shoulder, and the size-weighted big-print channel is the only candidate in this block that earned it.
cross_cutting_mbo_finding.attribution_split_summary: Four owned days, two direction changes. 20260602's flip is EARNED BY MY REASONING alone - the price-free absorption proxy, and it fires AGAINST the restored weather input (forecast_run_delta_cdd +1.163 argued up; the absorber read overrode it and was right). 20260527's flip is roughly HALF a RESTORED INPUT: the weather block was empty on 10/10 days for the blind, and 0527 is where forecast CDD steps 7.43 -> 8.197 with the block's FIRST positive forecast_run_delta_cdd (+0.118); the other half is my structural read (NGM26 calendar-front expiry day with squeeze_watch active and calendar_front_next_spread_chg_3d +0.056) plus the week-1 COT covering state. 20260526 and 20260603 keep the blind's sign; the improvement there is magnitude only and is MY REASONING (thin-tape guard on 0526, accumulation-arm trigger on 0603), with the restored weather corroborating but not deciding. vol_regime, being frozen at the 20260522 vintage and therefore IDENTICAL on all four days, contributed a block-level MAGNITUDE SCALE (1-sigma day-net ~650-740, mean 20d range ~1094, range percentile 81.7 = an already-elevated regime) and ZERO day-to-day discrimination - it must be credited for band width and for nothing else. Net: of the two direction fixes, one is bankable as forward evidence for a flow mechanism (0602) and one is not (0527).
